hooks.name: h1-summon-experiment
hooks.description: H1: when an experiment spec (.kiro/specs/experiments/<id>/requirements.md) is saved, scaffold the experiment plugin if it does not exist yet, otherwise sync the code with what changed in the spec.

action.prompt:
Hook H1 (summon-experiment) fired: a Seance experiment spec was saved. The saved file path is in the hook context; the experiment id is its folder name.

1. Read the saved requirements.md.
2. Read .kiro/steering/physics.md and .kiro/steering/units.md.
3. Let DIR = src/experiments/<id>/.
   - If DIR does NOT exist, scaffold it: index.ts, theory.ts, analysis.ts, uncertainty.ts, notebook.md.
   - If DIR DOES exist: diff the spec against the code, change only what the spec now requires differently.
4. Run tests for the experiment.
5. Reply with: files created or changed; test results; anything that looks wrong.
